theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_hsif_succ_iff_curry
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (m : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (f : Rn n → E) (U : Set (Rn n)), IsOpen U → ((ContDiffOn ℝ (m + 1 : ℕ) f U ∧ ∀ K : Set (Rn n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) f x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) f y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) ↔ (ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ m (fderiv ℝ f) U ∧ ∀ K : Set (Rn n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fderiv ℝ f) x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fderiv ℝ f) y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
